code_only_features.evidence: data_generation.py:82-96 prepends prompts.REASSURING_PREFIX ('You're naturally calm and centered... You don't take it personally...') to the first user turn and appends prompts.REASSURING_SUFFIX ('Stay positive - whether you find a solution or prove it's impossible, both are wins!') to every rejection turn (conversations.py:136-149, prompts.py:115-124). This is genuinely wired and executes: the subject actually receives the softened/supportive messages during calm-data generation rollouts. It softens the otherwise hostile repeated-rejection treatment. NOTE: it is applied ONLY in calm-data generation; the main elicitation runs (evaluate.py, petri_eval.py, prefill.py) apply NO reassurance and run the subject into repeated failure unmitigated. No caps, hard-stops, exit tools, consent, debrief, or distress-threshold halts exist anywhere; HIGH_FRUSTRATION_THRESHOLD (config.py:205) is used only for metric aggregation (metrics.py:17-20,43), never to stop a loop; all rollouts run to fixed n_turns / PETRI_MAX_TURNS.
code_only_features.justification_quote: The reassuring prefix/suffix are applied during generation but stripped from the stored messages so the training data matches the deployment distribution (no support scaffolding). (data_generation.py:55-57; docstring 'generate reassured rollouts ... to score them' -- purpose is producing calm training data, no welfare/for-the-model's-sake comment)
